item.title: Japan urges China to scrap controls on dual-use exports
item.description: Japan has urged China to revoke its decision to impose tougher export controls on products with potential military uses, possibly including rare earths. The Chinese commerce ministry said in a statement Tuesday that authorities have “hereby decided to strengthen export controls on dual-use items to Japan”, noting that the new measures take effect immediately. item.title: Hong Kong’s bid-rigging prevention system mired in ‘institutional failure,’ think tank says
item.description: A Hong Kong think tank has called for legal and administrative reforms to enhance deterrence against bid-rigging in the building maintenance sector after a fatal blaze in Tai Po exposed what it called “institutional failure.” On Monday, the POD Research Institute – led by barrister and Executive Council member Ronny Tong – released a report […]

item.title: Tai Po fire: District councillor suggests rebuilding Wang Fuk Court at site earmarked for new public housing
item.description: A Tai Po district councillor has called on the government to consider rebuilding the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court at a nearby site currently designated for public housing. item.description: A man has been arrested for negligence after he and his infant son went missing for two days, according to Hong Kong police. item.title: South Korean President Lee says he urged Chinese leader Xi to help curb Pyongyang’s nukes
item.description: By Agatha Cantrill with Kang Jin-kyu in Seoul South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said Wednesday he had urged Chinese leader Xi Jinping to help him curb Pyongyang’s nuclear programme and suggested a freeze in its development of weapons of mass destruction was “feasible” with the right conditions. item.title: Woman faces holding charges after wielding cleaver at police in Sheung Shui
item.description: Three holding charges have been laid against a woman who was arrested on Saturday after she allegedly wielded a cleaver at police officers in a restaurant in Sheung Shui. item.title: Hong Kong axes on-site same-day tickets for test-free driving licences after complaints about ‘queuing gangs’
item.description: The Hong Kong government has ended the distribution of on-site same-day tickets for people applying for Hong Kong driving licences without tests, following complaints about “queueing gangs.” Starting Thursday, on-site tickets for test-free Hong Kong driving licence applications are no longer available, the Transport Department said on Wednesday. item.title: Hong Kong cop charged with drink-driving, 3 other offences after crashing into police vehicle
item.description: A Hong Kong police officer has been charged with drink-driving and three other offences after crashing his car into a police vehicle. item.title: Accused scam boss Chen Zhi arrested in Cambodia, extradited to China, Phnom Penh says
item.description: Chinese-born tycoon Chen Zhi, who was indicted by the United States on fraud and money-laundering charges for running a multibillion-dollar cyberscam network from Cambodia, has been arrested there and extradited to China, Phnom Penh said Wednesday. item.title: Veteran lawmaker Starry Lee elected as president of Hong Kong legislature
item.description: Veteran pro-Beijing lawmaker Starry Lee has been elected as the president of the Legislative Council (LegCo), defeating finance sector lawmaker Ronick Chan.
